"""Independent Horizons root probe; writes new diagnostics, never baselines."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import sys

REPO = Path(r"C:\dev\moira-small-body-apsides")
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "anchored-asteroid-authority-probe-v2"
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))
from scripts import build_unified_asteroid_catalog as horizons
from scripts.build_apsidal_passages_fixture import _authority_metadata
from moira._spk_body_kernel import SmallBodyKernel

AU_KM = 149597870.7
ROOT = Path(r"C:\dev\moira-small-body-integration-validation-20261003\asteroids")
manifest_bytes = (ROOT / "manifest.json").read_bytes()
manifest = json.loads(manifest_bytes)
fixture_path = REPO / "tests/fixtures/horizons_apsidal_passages_reference_2026_09_28.json"
fixture_bytes = fixture_path.read_bytes()
fixture = json.loads(fixture_bytes)
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
results = []

def radial(state):
    radius = math.sqrt(sum(v * v for v in state[:3]))
    return sum(state[i] * state[i + 3] for i in range(3)) / radius

for record in fixture["records"]:
    if record["body"] not in {"Eros", "Chiron", "Sedna", "Eris"}:
        continue
    target = record["body_naif_id"]
    shard = next(s for s in manifest["shards"] if target in s["bodies"])
    reader = SmallBodyKernel(ROOT / shard["path"])
    try:
        start, end = reader.coverage_intervals_tdb(10, target)[0]
        receipts = []
        source_solution = None
        def states_at(epochs):
            global source_solution
            tags = sorted(set([start, end, *epochs]))
            raw = horizons._fetch_tlist_raw(f"{target - 2000000};", tags)
            authority = _authority_metadata(raw)
            if source_solution is None:
                source_solution = authority["target_solution"]
            assert authority["target_solution"] == source_solution
            raw_bytes = raw.encode("utf-8")
            name = f"{target}-{len(receipts):03d}.horizons.txt"
            with (OUT / name).open("xb") as stream:
                stream.write(raw_bytes)
            receipts.append({"epochs_jd_tdb": tags, "raw_response": name,
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw_bytes).hexdigest(),
                "bytes": len(raw_bytes), "authority": authority})
            parsed_epochs, columns = horizons._parse_vectors(raw)
            states = {}
            assert len(parsed_epochs) == len(tags)
            for requested in tags:
                i = min(range(len(parsed_epochs)), key=lambda j: abs(parsed_epochs[j] - requested))
                # Horizons prints fewer fractional JD digits than TLIST accepts.
                assert abs(parsed_epochs[i] - requested) <= 5e-9
                states[requested] = [column[i] for column in columns]
            return states

        for expected in record["events"]:
            lo, hi = expected["epoch_tdb"] - 0.05, expected["epoch_tdb"] + 0.05
            states = states_at([lo, hi])
            left, right = radial(states[lo]), radial(states[hi])
            pericenter = expected["kind"] == "PERICENTER"
            assert left <= 0 <= right if pericenter else left >= 0 >= right
            for iteration in range(20):
                slope = (right - left) / (hi - lo)
                epoch = lo - left / slope
                assert lo <= epoch <= hi
                state = states_at([epoch])[epoch]
                value = radial(state)
                if abs(value / slope) <= 2e-8:
                    break
                if (value < 0) == pericenter:
                    lo, left = epoch, value
                else:
                    hi, right = epoch, value
            else:
                raise RuntimeError("independent Horizons refinement did not converge")
            witnesses = states_at([epoch - 0.005, epoch + 0.005])
            before = radial(witnesses[epoch - 0.005])
            after = radial(witnesses[epoch + 0.005])
            assert before < 0 < after if pericenter else before > 0 > after
            position, velocity = reader.position_and_velocity_tdb(10, target, epoch)
            distance = math.sqrt(sum(v * v for v in state[:3])) / AU_KM
            kernel_distance = math.sqrt(sum(v * v for v in position)) / AU_KM
            comparison = {
                "body": record["body"], "body_naif_id": target,
                "kind": expected["kind"], "authority_epoch_tdb": epoch,
                "authority_distance_au": distance,
                "target_solution": source_solution,
                "historical_target_solution": expected["authority"]["target_solution"],
                "coverage_anchor_epochs_jd_tdb": [start, end],
                "historical_time_delta_seconds": (epoch - expected["epoch_tdb"]) * 86400,
                "historical_distance_delta_km": (distance - expected["distance_au"]) * AU_KM,
                "candidate_distance_delta_km": (kernel_distance - distance) * AU_KM,
                "candidate_vector_error_km": math.dist(position, state[:3]),
                "candidate_radial_velocity_km_s": sum(position[i] * velocity[i]
                    for i in range(3)) / math.sqrt(sum(v*v for v in position)) / 86400,
                "authority_radial_velocity_km_s": value,
                "two_sided_radial_velocity_km_s": [before, after],
                "requests": list(receipts),
            }
            results.append(comparison)
            print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in comparison.items()
                              if key != "requests"}), flush=True)
    finally:
        reader.close()

payload = {"schema": "moira.anchored-asteroid-authority-probe/v1",
    "retrieved_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "status": "new_source_diagnostic_not_baseline_promoted",
    "candidate_manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(manifest_bytes).hexdigest(),
    "historical_fixture_sha256": hashlib.sha256(fixture_bytes).hexdigest(),
    "method": "independent safeguarded secant roots on exact Horizons geometric ICRF km/s states; Sun center; exact TDB; every request includes coverage endpoints",
    "acceptance_gates": fixture["acceptance_gates"], "events": results}
with (OUT / "report.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    json.dump(payload, stream, indent=2)
    stream.write("\n")
